label: The deep-loop renderer was the last generator writing inside the OpenCode-visible command tree: .skilled/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/scripts/render-command-contract.cjs:24 held MANIFEST_PATH = .skilled/commands/deep/assets/compiled/manifest.jsonl, and appendManifestRow (lines 138-140, called for every render at lines 155-156) mkdir-recursed and appended into deep/assets/compiled/, re-materializing the folder phase 004 (f8f6156c2d) had emptied when it moved the twelve non-command markdown files out; decision 7 of phase 004 deliberately kept the manifest path, and commit 59565c1849 (2026-10-19, packet 009, verified ancestor of main HEAD) closed it by repointing MANIFEST_PATH (line 24), the legacy-projection-manifest.ts:200 pathTemplate and the compiled README line-112 validation snippet to .skilled/command-support/deep/assets/compiled/manifest.jsonl, and swapping the .gitignore rule (line 202) to the new path.

The untracked .skilled/commands/deep/assets/compiled/manifest.jsonl in the main checkout (57,884 bytes, mtime 2026-07-13) is not a regenerated file: no commit ever tracked that path (git log --all empty) and no runtime script reads or writes the old path anymore (rg over runtime scripts empty), so it is a July-era orphan of the pre-move writer that survived phase 004's tracked-only rename; it surfaced in main's git status only after 59565c1849 replaced the old-path .gitignore rule with the new-path rule. It is inert on both versions (only markdown files register as commands) but is stale pre-move data inside the live command tree and diverges the main checkout from fresh clones.

Registration risk post-merge is zero non-command registrations on both versions: .opencode/commands and .opencode/agents are symlinks to the single .skilled trees (verified, diff -rq zero differences), and both hosts register only markdown files - the v2 isolated listing shows commands:41 with moved-file entries:[] (v2-command-isolated.txt:2-3), where 41 = 39 tree commands of that snapshot plus the two non-tree builtin entries init and review present in every captured listing (command-listing-before.txt:95,97; command-listing-after.txt:83,85), with no user-level ~/.config/opencode/commands directory; the residual non-command files in the tree (README.txt files, deep/assets/*.yaml|*.txt, scripts/validate-command-references.cjs, scripts/fixtures/broken-command-refs.yaml) are absent from every listing, and v1 parity is pinned by REQ-006 in the 004 spec. Watch-items for listing batteries: subtract the builtin entries and normalize OpenCode 2's walk-up merge of ancestor .opencode folders (decision 13, spec line 134), which makes nested-worktree listings supersets of isolated ones.

Every dual-read surface reads the same on OpenCode 1.19.3 and 2.0.32: .opencode/commands and .opencode/agents are symlinks to the single .skilled trees; opencode.json keeps the v1 shape which OpenCode 2 converts on load, guarded by .skilled/bin/tests/opencode-config-shape.test.cjs which fails on a v2-only key; the agent mirrors (.claude/.codex/.pi/.hermes) were patched and checker-verified in phase 004. The generator/validator fixed-list sweep (iteration 2's carried sub-angle) closes clean: compile-command-contracts.cjs writes contract bodies at .skilled/command-support/deep/assets/compiled (lines 699,740) and holds no manifest writer, the renderer/registry/template/gitignore/README all agree on the command-support manifest path since 59565c1849, and validate-command-references.cjs walks readdirSync dynamically with only README.md/.contract.md skips (line 201) - no fixed file list remains in the merged generator surface; cross-branch docs remain un-swept by this iteration.

Remediation bundle for A26: (1) one-time cleanup in the main checkout - delete the orphaned untracked .skilled/commands/deep/assets/compiled/ directory, which contains only the July-era manifest.jsonl; no gitignore re-entry is needed because the old path is retired; (2) keep the 59565c1849 relocation as merged - writer, projection template, README snippet and gitignore all agree on .skilled/command-support/deep/assets/compiled/manifest.jsonl, whose live gate still renders exit 0 (009 scratch/gates/render-manifest-live.txt); (3) harden the doctor and listing batteries to normalize both versions' listings by subtracting the builtin entries (init, review) and accounting for OpenCode 2's ancestor walk-up so nested-worktree comparisons compare isolated-equivalent sets; (4) later polish, not a bug: consider relocating the per-render manifest append out of the .skilled source tree into a build or state directory per the sk-code-skilled contract that the commands tree holds only commands.

Both phase-004 listing captures contain the entries init and review (command-listing-before.txt:95,97; command-listing-after.txt:83,85) that correspond to no repository file, with no user-level ~/.config/opencode/commands directory present, so both versions' listing surfaces include runtime-provided builtin entries that listing-based checks must subtract.

speckit/handoff.md was added on Oct 18 by b830fd0276 (the self-relaunching session loop work) and is absent from both 004 listing captures, so the 41-vs-40 listing delta against today's tree is fully explained by the two builtin entries, not by a registration skip.
